chapter: Philadelphia and the McRae Brothers Band, 1908-1929
title: Dr. Miller urges him to study medicine
summary: The Philadelphia druggist, who held a post at Hahnemann Hospital, pushed McRae toward medicine, but money was short and the band took him to Atlantic City.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Teddy, let's back up a bit.
Okay. Let's go back to uh...
You studied medicine. Tell us a little about that. Where did you study?

Yes. When I was working in the drug store with Dr. Miller, he thought that I could have -- he was interested in me going into medicine. "Come on, why don't you be a doctor? What you wanna mess with music for?" I said, "Well, you know, I don't think my mother has that kind of money. It takes a lot of money to be a doctor." He said, "Oh no." He had a position
